records.subject: Welcome aboard, Lantern Analytics
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Day 6, no project, no invite, no key milestone (stall_reasons). Customer is friendly and responsive [email:64f01d71] but deferred a walkthrough vaguely ("at some point"), with no stated intent or deadline, and took no action after two touches [email:04dded92, email:6d0dd93b]. Starter plan, no tickets. Engaged but passive, so modest unaided odds in 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Glad to hear the first week's going well — and yes, let's do that walkthrough. Would a 20-minute call this week work? I can walk you through setting up your first project and getting your team in.

Two things that may help in the meantime: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Just reply with a day that suits and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Priya
